tasks.short: Coordinate survey findings with engineers, architects, clients and other project participants.

steps.what: Find current survey findings and related engineering or architectural drawing revisions
Discuss actual findings, resolve discrepancies and agree interfaces with project participants
Annotate and check actual agreed interfaces, discrepancies and follow-up in the coordination record
outputs: checked coordination record and recipient copy

inputs: checked coordination record and recipient copy

steps.what: Send the checked recipient copy to the agreed project participants
inputs: checked coordination record and recipient copy

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} revision links for actual survey and project drawings. Retain discrepancy discussion, actual annotation and checked separate save and send.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision filters and pinned links.
tasks.human_edge: Explain survey limits and negotiate defensible interfaces.
tasks.altitude: Less revision hunting; coordination authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native revision views reduce locating current survey and design documents, not resolving their discrepancies.

assumptions: Boundary is findings coordination through its actual annotated record and recipient copy. Survey and design authors supply document IDs, revisions, coordinate reference and findings; surveyor verifies in s1 and captures actual decisions in s3. Missing revisions require manual checking.

Native first; existing configured links earn zero. Shares provisional not measured. Ordinary annotation checking includes recipients, no extra approval meeting. Save and send1 each fully retained; no same-system click saving.
unknowns: Current revision access and actual record requirements
research_questions: Does native revision filtering remove repeated document hunting?

incremental.description: Check revision links and project access

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked recipient copy and project destinations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional10 retrieval units reduced50 percent saves5 minus0.5 upkeep=4.5. Half eligible gives2. Discussion70, annotation18 and actions2 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze objectives and specifications to prepare or direct survey proposals.

steps.what: Read and clarify actual survey objectives, specifications, site constraints and client requirements
Choose survey approach, acceptance criteria, staffing and instructions for any proposal contributor
outputs: chosen survey approach and contributor instructions

steps.what: Enter checked quantities and rates and calculate the actual survey effort estimate
inputs: chosen survey approach and contributor instructions

steps.what: Write and check the final proposal or contributor brief against actual scope and estimate
inputs: chosen survey approach and contributor instructions
outputs: checked final proposal or contributor brief

loop.purpose: Draft the actual proposal or proposal-preparation brief
loop.input: Checked requirements, chosen approach and checked estimate
loop.output: Draft scope, method, assumptions, exclusions and deliverables
loop.check: Surveyor verifies actual promised coverage, accuracy, exclusions, staffing and estimate; rejects unsupported commitments, altered acceptance criteria or omitted constraints.
loop.stop: Missing scope evidence or two failed revisions returns to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native estimate formulas and document headings handle fixed data first; variable scope explanation needs prose composition.

steps.what: Send the checked final proposal or contributor brief to its authorised recipient
inputs: checked final proposal or contributor brief

tasks.design: Configure native {SPREADSHEET} estimate formulas and {DOCS} proposal headings first. A bounded drafting loop explains the surveyor-selected approach and checked estimate; the surveyor checks the final version before sending a proposal or preparation brief.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculation templates and evidence-bounded drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing methods and making defensible accuracy commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous objectives and own the promised scope.
tasks.altitude: Less estimate assembly and drafting; survey scope authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: estimate templates calculate from checked quantities and rates; bounded drafting can express selected survey scope subject to surveyor review.

assumptions: Boundary is own proposal preparation or direction of contributors, not their separately owned labour. Client supplies objectives and specifications; surveyor chooses approach in s2 and enters quantities, staffing, rates and contingency assumptions in s3. Missing rates or quantities require manual estimation, not extraction assumed free.

Native first; existing estimate automation earns zero. Provisional shares, no measured baseline. s3 retains capture and arithmetic checks; s4 includes actual final scope and recipient review, no new approval ceremony. External recipient assumed for the send; internal contributor sends instead have write_internal authority and unchanged effort. Send1 retained.
unknowns: Current estimate templates and authority to issue proposals
research_questions: Do generated scope paragraphs preserve all stated exclusions and accuracy commitments?

incremental.description: Maintain estimate rates, headings and draft audit samples

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked complete final proposal or brief and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional estimate20 at50 remaining saves10 and drafting24 at50 saves12; gross22 minus2 upkeep=20. Half eligible estimates and drafts gives9. Requirements and method choices unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify as an expert witness on land-survey issues.

steps.what: Locate the actual court bundle, survey records and relevant boundary exhibits
inputs: existing court bundle and survey records

steps.what: Read actual evidence and prepare defensible testimony on measurements, boundaries and limitations
Give actual expert testimony and answer court questions on land-survey issues

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} case-bundle bookmarks for locating actual exhibits. Preserve full evidence reading, expert preparation and live testimony; no generated boundary opinion is used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding exhibits in a large case bundle.
tasks.enabler_now: Native bundle bookmarks and document links.
tasks.still_hard: Defending measurement and boundary interpretations under questioning.
tasks.human_edge: Provide independent expert judgement and explain uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Less exhibit hunting; expert responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document bookmarks can reduce exhibit finding, not expert evidence analysis or courtroom testimony.

assumptions: Boundary is testimony and actual evidence preparation. Existing bundle producer supplies case ID, document IDs, page references and final exhibits. Surveyor verifies missing references manually. No new report or personal testimony note is assumed: court recording is existing court work, not surveyor labour removed here.

Native first; already bookmarked bundles earn zero. Provisional shares not measured. Source reading and opinion formation remain full effort; an actual written expert report would need its own separately timed draft and gate, no saving claimed for it here.
unknowns: Current bundle indexing and actual preparation duties
research_questions: How much preparation is exhibit finding rather than evidence reading?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional10 exhibit-finding units at60 remaining saves4 minus0.5 upkeep=3.5. Half eligible gives1.5. Thirty evidence-preparation and60 testimony units unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop criteria for survey methods and procedures.

steps.what: Read actual survey requirements, reference standards and prior method validation evidence
Determine method selection criteria, tolerances, checks and exception procedures
Write and check the complete method criteria and procedure specification
Save the checked final method criteria specification

tasks.design: Configure a native {DOCS} standards index and criteria template for scope, tolerances, checks and exceptions. The surveyor chooses every criterion and checks the final specification; no automatic standards interpretation is used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dispersed standards and repeated specification layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and procedure templates.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing defensible tolerances across actual field conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Translate survey use into practical, testable method requirements.
tasks.altitude: Less source finding and layout; method authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native standards indexes and document templates reduce source finding and repeated layout without setting survey criteria.

assumptions: Boundary ends at developed method specification, not separate organisational rollout. Standards producer supplies source title, revision and text; surveyor reads and verifies actual references in s1, chooses criteria in s2, and records tolerances, checks and exception rules in s3. Missing sources or unsuitable template fields require manual work.

Native first; existing indexes or templates earn zero. Provisional shares not measured. Source interpretation and final accuracy check stay human. Save1 fully retained schema granularity; no added approval ceremony.
research_questions: Which actual specification layout and source-finding work remains manual?

incremental.description: Maintain standard revision links and criteria headings

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final method criteria specification
